{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索日影驿站记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"庭院守工按霜原积雪厚度扫雪，不参与通道邮路或日期换算。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-DSDV","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A2c9b988d-7d73-4988-983f-e93743f7da8e:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:2c9b988d-7d73-4988-983f-e93743f7da8e"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["庭院守工按霜原积雪厚度扫雪，不参与通道邮路或日期换算。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"日影界第三日信件进入通道，霜原界记作第九刻；两界尚未确认一般日期换算关系。通道规约写明：只有实际入道的信件才会出现在霜原界。驿站门帘染着浅褐色。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-DSDV","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aca55e002-d72d-4639-bfda-cdbbb4f4b1d0:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:ca55e002-d72d-4639-bfda-cdbbb4f4b1d0"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["日影界第三日信件进入通道，霜原界记作第九刻；两界尚未确认一般日期换算关系。通道规约写明：只有实际入道的信件才会出现在霜原界。驿站门帘染着浅褐色。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"夏衡验到已入道的信件，送达目标完成；闻秋依据错误换算仍提交六天延误申诉。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-DSDV","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Af232cbd9-8b6b-41f4-89ce-253f14283902:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:f232cbd9-8b6b-41f4-89ce-253f14283902"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["夏衡验到已入道的信件，送达目标完成；闻秋依据错误换算仍提交六天延误申诉。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"闻秋把九刻当作第九日，以为信迟到了六天；夏衡知道这里只记录了一次入道对应。夏衡依据实际入道记录在霜原界查验同一封信，不外推其他日期。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-DSDV","spanRef
